name: Kissing
author: modChad
description: Hold K to kiss the pony in front of you, no carrying needed: she comes to you and reaches up to your lips. In VR, lean in close. Whether she kisses back, and how deeply, follows the game's own friendship and romance rules. Her excitement builds instead of bursting: a unicorn's horn glows and hums softly, growing with the kiss and your bond; a pegasus's spread wings shiver; an earth pony grows fidgety. Ponies nearby remember seeing it.
